title: TodayWeather for iOS · Tracking settings
scenario: Review the tracking choice for TodayWeather and open the app’s page in iOS Settings. The weather pages show saved sample weather on an iPhone 12 Pro Max.

steps.title: Read your tracking choice
steps.instruction: Open the side menu and scroll past About (정보) to Tracking permission (추적 허용 설정). Tap the row to open TodayWeather in iOS Settings.
steps.caption: The row below 광고 개인정보 선택 shows 허용 안 함 when tracking is off.
steps.expected: The row shows 허용됨 when tracking is allowed. It appears after iOS can report an allowed or denied choice.

steps.title: Open Settings from Hourly weather
steps.instruction: Open Hourly (시간별날씨) and scroll past the forecast and its sources. With tracking off, tap 설정 열기 at the bottom.
steps.caption: The explanation and Open Settings button are part of the scrolling Hourly page.
steps.expected: iOS opens the settings for TodayWeather. Choose whether to allow tracking where iOS offers the switch.

steps.title: Review the switch in iOS Settings
steps.instruction: Look for Allow Tracking (추적 허용) in the settings for TodayWeather. Choose the setting you prefer, then return to the app.
steps.caption: The switch is off in this example. Its availability depends on the iOS tracking settings for this device.
steps.expected: The menu shows your current choice the next time TodayWeather is active.

steps.title: Find the shortcut in Daily weather
steps.instruction: Open Daily (일별날씨) and scroll to the end of the forecast.
steps.caption: The Daily page also offers 설정 열기 while tracking is off.
steps.expected: All forecast features remain available with either tracking choice.

steps.title: Find the shortcut in Air quality
steps.instruction: Open Air (대기정보) and scroll to the end of the station readings and source details.
steps.caption: The same tracking choice and shortcut apply to the Air page.
steps.expected: After you allow tracking in Settings and reopen the app, the notice disappears from all three weather pages.

steps.title: Confirm an allowed choice
steps.instruction: After allowing tracking in iOS Settings, reopen the menu in TodayWeather and read 추적 허용 설정.
steps.caption: The permission row now reads 추적 허용 설정 · 허용됨.
steps.expected: The notice has disappeared from Hourly, Daily and Air. You can still reopen iOS Settings from this menu.
